title: Electronic and ring size effects of N-heterocyclic carbenes on the kinetics of ligand substitution reactions and DNA/protein interactions of their palladium(II) complexes.
authors: Omondi, Reinner O; Jaganyi, Deogratius; Ojwach, Stephen O
journal: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钯(II)配合物的配体取代动力学及与DNA/BSA的相互作用，虽涉及DNA结合但为小分子金属配合物体系，无TF-DNA互作建模，且方法仅含DFT模拟，与课题核心不匹配。
abstract: The synthesis, substitution kinetics and DNA/BSA interactions of four cationic Pd(II) complexes [Pd(1)Cl]BF(4) (Pd1), [Pd(2)Cl]BF(4) (Pd2), [Pd(3)Cl]BF(4) (Pd3) and [Pd(4)Cl]BF(4) (Pd4), derived from the reaction of [PdCl(2)(NCCH(3))(2)] with ligands 2,6-bis(3-methylimidazolium-1-yl)pyridine dibromide (1), 2,6-bis(3-ethylimidazolium-1-yl)pyridine dibromide (2), 2,6-bis(1-methylimidazole-2-thione)pyridine (3), and 2,6-bis(1-ethylimidazole-2-thione)pyridine (4), respectively are reported. The complexes were characterised by various spectroscopic techniques and single crystal X-ray diffraction for compound Pd2. Kinetic reactivity of the complexes with the biologically relevant nucleophiles thiourea (Tu), L-methionine (L-Met) and guanosine 5'-monophosphate sodium salt (5'-GMP) was in the order: Pd1 > Pd2 > Pd3 > Pd4, which was largely dependent on the electronic and ring size of the chelate ligands, consistent with Density functional theory (DFT) simulations. The interactions of the complexes with calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) and bovine serum albumin (BSA) binding titrations showed strong binding. Both the experimental and in silico data reveal CT-DNA intercalative binding mode.
abstract_zh: 报道了四种阳离子Pd(II)配合物[Pd(1)Cl]BF(4) (Pd1)、[Pd(2)Cl]BF(4) (Pd2)、[Pd(3)Cl]BF(4) (Pd3)和[Pd(4)Cl]BF(4) (Pd4)的合成、取代动力学及DNA/BSA相互作用，这些配合物分别由[PdCl(2)(NCCH(3))(2)]与配体2,6-双(3-甲基咪唑鎓-1-基)吡啶二溴化物(1)、2,6-双(3-乙基咪唑鎓-1-基)吡啶二溴化物(2)、2,6-双(1-甲基咪唑-2-硫酮)吡啶(3)和2,6-双(1-乙基咪唑-2-硫酮)吡啶(4)反应制得。通过多种光谱技术对配合物进行了表征，并对化合物Pd2进行了单晶X射线衍射分析。配合物与生物相关亲核试剂硫脲(Tu)、L-蛋氨酸(L-Met)和鸟苷5'-单磷酸钠盐(5'-GMP)的反应活性顺序为：Pd1 > Pd2 > Pd3 > Pd4，这主要取决于螯合配体的电子效应和环大小，与密度泛函理论(DFT)模拟结果一致。配合物与小牛胸腺DNA(CT-DNA)和牛血清白蛋白(BSA)的结合滴定实验显示强结合作用。实验和计算机模拟数据均揭示了CT-DNA嵌入结合模式。
